verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted email service and its apps, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. A community remark that Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled' describes transparency, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
